name: Kizaki Sae
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c9425]Harukii's[/url] wife. She's 39 years old and the two of them have been married for 20 years. When [url=http://vndb.org/c9421]Sena[/url] tells everyone at the dinner table that she saw her father playing with the breasts of another woman at school she leaves him. She thinks that life without sex for a month will be punishment enough to get him to learn his lesson. Afterward he often sees her in dreams.

When she moves out she takes [url=http://vndb.org/c9421]Sena[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c9423]Kanami[/url] with her. After two weeks she lets them move back in with their father while she takes [url=http://vndb.org/c9420]Ayame[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c9422]Hyouka[/url] instead.
